GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (21 Dec 45) CCS
(SCAPIN-479)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Authorization of Press Wireless to handle Wire Overflow Holiday Traffic.
1. You are hereby advised that the Press Wireless Company has been authorized to handle, between the dates of 15 December and 15 January, full rate, LC and VLT messages between Japan and the United States, that other companies cannot handle. This temporary arrangement is necessary because it is anticipated that Holiday Traffic may be more than the authorized companies can handle.
2. It must be clearly understood that this does not mean an equal distribution between other companies and Press Wireless as Press Wireless is only to handle such messages as other companies are unable to send.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A. G. D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
